intro: Clang! Clang! The sound of a hammer rings out!
title: Tinkaton's Forge
description:
A Tinkaton is pounding away at something on an anvil!
Maybe it'll take a request?

1.label: Ask it to forge some gear
1.selected: Tinkaton happily swung its hammer!$Some useful items were made!

2.label: Forge the steel
2.tooltip:
(+) Forged Steel: 2 for a Steel type, 1 for others
(+) Base HP, Def and Sp. Def +10% per piece (up to 10)
2.disabledTooltip:
(-) No party member holds
fewer than 10 Forged Steel
2.prompt:
Choose a Pokémon to forge.
(Steel types get 2, others 1)
2.fullyForged: That Pokémon already holds the most Forged Steel it can (10)!
2.selected: Tinkaton gave {{forgedPokemon}} a mighty pounding!${{forgedPokemon}} got {{forgedCount}} Forged Steel, and its body became even sturdier!

3.label: A friendly spar with Tinkaton!
3.selected: Tinkaton tightened its grip on its hammer!$Let the friendly spar begin!
